## Week 9 - Appendix


### Output Format Instructions

  ```
  The output should be formatted as a JSON instance that conforms to the JSON schema below.

  As an example, for the schema {"properties": {"foo": {"title": "Foo", "description": "a list of strings", "type":
  "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}}, "required": ["foo"]}
  the object {"foo": ["bar", "baz"]} is a well-formatted instance of the schema. The object {"properties": {"foo": ["bar",
  "baz"]}} is not well-formatted.

  Here is the output schema:
  ```
  ```json
  {
    "$defs": {
      "DetectedObject": {
        "properties": {
          "aabb_2d": {
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "title": "Aabb 2D",
            "type": "array"
          },
          "segmentation_mask": {
            "description": "Segmentation mask for the object, provided as a Base64 PNG string",
            "title": "Segmentation Mask",
            "type": "string"
          },
          <... more properties ...>
          "is_moving": {
            "description": "True if the object belongs to a class that is commonly moving, e.g. a vehicle or person",
            "title": "Is Moving",
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "aabb_2d",
          "segmentation_mask",
          "label",
          "approx_distance",
          "height",
          "is_hazard",
          "is_dynamic",
          "is_crowd",
          "is_moving"
        ],
        "title": "DetectedObject",
        "type": "object"
      }
    },
    "description": "Complete analysis of a scene for navigation assistance.",
    "properties": {
      "objects": {
        "description": "List of detected objects in the scene",
        "items": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/DetectedObject"
        },
        "title": "Objects",
        "type": "array"
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "objects"
    ]
  }
  ```

### Problems Complying with Output Format Instructions
  ```
  The output should be formatted as a JSON instance that conforms to the JSON schema below.

  As an example, for the schema {"properties": {"foo": {"title": "Foo", "description": "a list of strings", "type":
  "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}}, "required": ["foo"]}
  the object {"foo": ["bar", "baz"]} is a well-formatted instance of the schema. The object {"properties": {"foo": ["bar",
  "baz"]}} is not well-formatted.

  Here is the output schema:
  {
    "$defs": {
      "AABBDetection": {
        "properties": {
          "label": {
            "description": "Concise and unique instance label with distinguishing characteristics (snake_case)",
            "title": "Label",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "box_2d": {
            "description": "List of integer AABB coordinates in the format  from 0-1000",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "title": "Box 2D",
            "type": "array"
          },
          "mask": {
            "description": "Segmentation mask for the object, provided as a base64 PNG string",
            "title": "Mask",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "label",
          "box_2d",
          "mask"
        ],
        "title": "AABBDetection",
        "type": "object"
      }
    },
    "description": "Complete analysis of a scene for navigation assistance.",
    "properties": {
      "objects": {
        "description": "List of detected objects in the scene",
        "items": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AABBDetection"
        },
        "title": "Objects",
        "type": "array"
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "objects"
    ]
  }
  ```
